scenarios.name: Orders sandbox operations review
scenarios.summary: A fictional operations team reviews supplied evidence for the orders workload in a sandbox: bounded fleet targets, CloudFormation changes, identity and root protection, change attribution, cost allocation, logs, Linux configuration, delivery proposals, host telemetry and alarm evaluation. All records are authored, read-only exercise evidence; no AWS resources, credentials, shell or executable workspace are provisioned. Code, configuration and operation excerpts for non-table anchors are carried in lesson text, not executed.
